articles.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
articles.description: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.

articles.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds
articles.description: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
articles.description: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.

articles.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
articles.description: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.

articles.title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
articles.description: Most codes of conduct serve as a reflection of corporate culture. In Nvidia's case, that could have consequences.

articles.title: The canceled Tesla Cybertruck is the fastest-selling used truck in America
articles.description: The Tesla Cybertruck was the fastest-selling used truck last month, averaging just 39.1 days on the market compared to 65.5 days for trucks overall.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
articles.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation backs Keccak-256 to counter quantum, AI threats
articles.description: Ethlabs co-founder Julian Ma told Cointelegraph that AI poses a more immediate threat as Ethereum prepares for one of its biggest security overhauls since the Merge.

articles.title: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe
articles.description: The password manager maker said an attacker gained access to an employee's corporate account and took some information about customers.

articles.title: French Senate blocks new crypto tax and wallet list critics called a kidnapping risk
articles.description: The government opposed the measures citing existing EU data-sharing rules and non-legal tender status, leaving the 2027 budget open.

articles.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
articles.description: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

articles.title: US inflation rises to 3.8% ahead of December Fed meeting, clouding crypto outlook
articles.description: US core inflation rose more than expected in October as markets anticipate a December interest rate hike, which could slow a crypto market recovery.

articles.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
articles.description: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

articles.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs
articles.description: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls toward $57K amid US tariff fears, hot PCE data as Nasdaq drops 4%
articles.description: The prospect of higher US tariffs and hotter-than-expected PCE inflation weighed on Bitcoin, crypto and stocks on Wednesday.

articles.title: Nvidia agrees to $290M settlement over crypto mining revenue disclosures
articles.description: The proposed settlement would resolve a shareholder lawsuit dating back to 2018 that alleged Nvidia misled investors about its exposure to the cryptocurrency industry.

articles.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1M satellites for orbital AI data centers
articles.description: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.

articles.title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
articles.description: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

articles.title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
articles.description: Lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak said he expects roughly $330 million (15 billion hryvnias) in added budget revenue, though the time frame remains unclear.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
articles.description: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%.
